implementation_contract.input: Java int; positive, negative and zero are accepted
implementation_contract.allowed_operation: for any nonnegative exponent n, add or subtract 2^n
implementation_contract.result: minimum number of allowed operations required to reach zero
implementation_contract.negative_values: the optimum is computed from the absolute magnitude because the operation set is sign-symmetric
implementation_contract.overflow: absolute magnitude and intermediate carry are computed in long so Integer.MIN_VALUE is handled safely

checks: zero, positive and negative fixed cases
powers of two and values adjacent to powers of two
runs of low one-bits such as 7, 15 and 31
differential comparison against an independent memoized oracle that explores both odd branches instead of reusing the production mod-4 greedy rule
